faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position at Allahabad University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position at Allahabad University is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRA post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Life Science, Environmental Science, or a related discipline with a first-class academic record to be eligible for the Junior Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any such provisions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000/- per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the post of Junior Research Assistant (JRA)".

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to submit a single PDF file containing a filled application form, self-attested copies of mark sheets, certificates, proof of research/experience, and a domicile certificate.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or project-based job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment, meaning the position is for the duration of the specific research project.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CST/ENV/D-1010.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
